title: Knifed
description: This is a fabric mod for 1.21.8 that adds various amounts of knifes
body:
## Knifes
- This is a mod that adds various amounts of knifes for fabric minecraft 1.21.8 with varying amount of damage and attack speed 
- knifes include : Flint knife, Iron knife, Diamond Knife, Gold knife and the best of all the Netherite knife
